items.evidence: Earnings —2016 earnings and earnings per share met Business Plan targets
Net cash flow —We remain on target to be cash flow breakeven at $50 Brent in 2017.
Divestiture proceeds —$2.8 billion in sales proceeds were realized in 2016.
Return on capital employed (ROCE) —2016 annual ROCE performance beat the Business Plan objective
Capital and exploratory expenditures (C&E) —C&E totaled $22.4 billion in 2016
Net production of 2.594 million barrels of oil-equivalent per day was slightly below the external guidance
Operating expenses and selling, general and administrative expenses totaled $25.0 billion, well under the Business Plan
Refining unit utilization rates exceeded the Business Plan by 1.4 percent.
Maintained industry-leading personal safety rates, better than the Business Plan
Achieved record low spills and had continued improvement in lowering both the number and the impact of loss of containment incidents.
the CEO and the other NEOs all received a 1.0 Individual Performance Factor (IPF)
The majority of the LTIP award derives value directly from TSR (relative and absolute).
